access: Entry level includes icons and labels
No repeated icons within a board
Progression from pictures to printed words

preparation.label: Print one level and cut the calling cards
preparation.materials: Paper or card stock; optional laminate and counters

teaching_steps.title: Choose
teaching_steps.detail: Select one level for the group.

teaching_steps.title: Call
teaching_steps.detail: Draw and name one reviewed concept.

teaching_steps.title: Match
teaching_steps.detail: Cover the matching icon or printed word.

scarborough.statement: Reinforces rapid recognition of reviewed concepts through a turn-taking game.
